component.name: Share Control
component.summary: Manage Samba shares from a declarative access matrix

description.p: A Cockpit module for administering Samba shares through a declarative device-by-share access matrix.

The matrix file on disk is the source of truth. Share Control renders and edits that file, then invokes the generator which validates the result and installs it — so share policy stays diffable and reviewable in version control, instead of living in a database behind the interface.
